name: board-deck-fact-checker
description: Fact-checks a board deck against its source spreadsheets: it reads the deck (a file link or name, or pasted slide text), extracts every numeric claim (revenue, ARR, burn, headcount, customers, percentages, growth rates, ratios), finds the cell each claim should come from and compares the numbers in code with explicit rules: rounding to half the last written digit, truncation labelled, strict or loose on request, growth and ratios recomputed from the cells, and the period must match. It lists every mismatch with slide, claim, deck value, source value and cell reference, the claims it could not verify, and the same figure stated differently on two slides. Pasted source rows work without any connector. Read-only: it never edits the deck or the sheets and does not judge whether a number is good.

skills.name: Board deck fact check
skills.description: Numeric claims in a board deck checked against the source spreadsheet cells (or pasted source rows) in code: mismatches with cell references and materiality, unverifiable claims, period mismatches and in-deck inconsistencies. Read-only.
